question: India with its area of 3.28 million km² accounts for 2.4 per cent of the world's land surface area and stands as the ______ largest country in the world.
solution:
**The correct answer is the __seventh__**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s total geographical area:**

 
 
• India's total geographical area is about 3.28 million square kilometers.
 
• This area accounts for approximately 2.4 per cent of the total geographical area of the world.
 
• India is the seventh-largest country in the world by land area.
 
• Despite its relatively small size compared to other large nations, India has a significant population, making it the second most populous country in the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other comparative statistics:**

 
 
• **Canada**: The second-largest country by area, Canada accounts for about **6.1%** of the world’s total land area.
 
• **Brazil**: The fifth-largest country by area, Brazil accounts for about **5.7%** of the world’s total land area.
 
• **Australia**: The sixth-largest country by area, Australia accounts for about **5.3%** of the world’s total land area.
 
• **India**: The seventh-largest country by area, India accounts for about **2.3%** of the world’s total land area.
 
• **Argentina**: The eighth-largest country by area, Argentina accounts for about **1.7%** of the world’s total land area.
 
• **Kazakhstan**: The ninth-largest country by area, Kazakhstan accounts for about **1.6%** of the world’s total land area.
 
• **Algeria**: The tenth-largest country by area, Algeria accounts for about **1.5%** of the world’s total land area.
